title: MOAI: Module-Optimizing Architecture for non-interactive secure transformer Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.13641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy concerns have been raised in Large Language Models (LLM) inference when models are deployed in Cloud Service Providers (CSP). Homomorphic encryption (HE) offers a promising solution by enabling secure inference directly over encrypted inputs. However, the high computational overhead of HE remains a major bottleneck. To address this challenge, we propose MOAI, an efficient HE-based, non-interactive framework for secure transformer inference. MOAI gains significant efficiency improvement from: (1) a novel evaluation flow that combines column and diagonal packing with consistent strategies across all layers, eliminating expensive format conversions. (2) rotation-free algorithms for Softmax and LayerNorm that significantly reduce the number of costly HE rotations, removing 2,448 HE rotations in BERT-base inference. translated_title: MOAI：面向非交互式安全Transformer推理的模块优化架构
translated_abstract: 当大型语言模型（LLM）部署在云服务提供商（CSP）上进行推理时，引发了隐私方面的担忧。同态加密（HE）通过直接在加密输入上执行安全推理，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，同态加密高昂的计算开销仍然是主要瓶颈。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了MOAI，一个高效的基于同态加密的非交互式安全Transformer推理框架。MOAI在以下方面获得了显著的效率提升：（1）一种新颖的评估流程，将列打包与对角线打包相结合，并在所有层中采用一致的策略，从而消除了昂贵的格式转换；（2）无旋转的Softmax和LayerNorm算法，显著减少了昂贵的同态加密旋转操作次数，在BERT-base推理中消除了2,448次同态加密旋转；（3）列打包消除了明文-密文矩阵乘法中的旋转操作，而交错批处理进一步降低了开销。
tldr: MOAI提出了一个基于同态加密的非交互式安全Transformer推理框架，通过统一的列/对角线打包评估流程、无旋转的Softmax和LayerNorm算法以及交错批处理等模块级优化，大幅消除了昂贵的HE旋转操作与格式转换，显著提升了加密推理效率。
en_tdlr: MOAI is a non-interactive, homomorphic-encryption-based framework for secure transformer inference that achieves significant efficiency gains through unified column/diagonal packing, rotation-free Softmax and LayerNorm algorithms, and interleaved batching, eliminating thousands of costly HE rotations and format conversions.
